Good to know

Comfort questions, answered.

Should I repair or replace my system?

It depends on the system’s age, repair history, efficiency, and the cost of the current problem. A thorough diagnosis should give you enough context to compare both paths without pressure.

How often should HVAC equipment be checked?

A seasonal check before heavy cooling or heating use is a practical rhythm for many homes. The right schedule can vary based on equipment, usage, and household needs.

What can I check before requesting service?

Confirm the thermostat is set correctly, the breaker has not tripped, vents are open, and the filter is reasonably clean. If you smell gas, see smoke, or hear alarming sounds, leave the system off and seek immediate professional help.

Can you help with uneven temperatures?

Yes. Uneven comfort can be related to airflow, ductwork, insulation, equipment sizing, or controls. The first step is identifying which factors are actually present in your home.
